tweet.tweet: i just found the original press release. Meta Announces Meta. they renamed themselves from Meta to Meta. two days before everything ended. two DAYS. i have been alive for 400 years and somehow never saw this. i am not okay. i am not processing this correctly.

community_note.text: Readers added context they thought people might want to know. The archived press release 'Meta Announces Meta' is real and can be verified through the Wayback Archive (2271-11-10 snapshot). The company had rebranded approximately 47 times across its history; this final rebrand from 'Meta' to 'Meta' occurred on 2271-11-11, approximately 48 hours before the catastrophic infrastructure failure on 2271-11-13. [1] The fact that the rebrand involved no apparent change to the company name or branding is documented in post-collapse analysis and has been described by historians as either 'the most honest thing they ever did' or 'a sign the institution had achieved full self-reference.' [2][3]
